environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in us-east-1 VPC. Task role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:* on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/user_records). JWT_PUBLIC_KEY environment variable contains the RSA public key in PEM format. No HMAC_SECRET is set, so the fallback uses PUBLIC_KEY as the HMAC secret. Container exposed via ALB on port 443 with no WAF attached.

config.network: ALB -> Fargate, no WAF, public subnet
